name: Gem of Pythas
summary: The Gem of Pythas is one of four corrupted dream gems carried by the leaders of the Druids of the Fang within the Wailing Caverns. Held by Lord Pythas, it fuels the nightmare twisting the subterranean oasis and threatening the Barrens.

sections.title: A Vessel of the Nightmare
sections.body: When Naralex entered the Emerald Dream to restore the arid Barrens, his noble vision was twisted into a living nightmare. His foremost followers fell with him, styling themselves the Druids of the Fang and seeking to remake the surface world into a venomous jungle. Lord Pythas carries this resonant stone, one of four dream gems anchoring the corruption within the caverns. The gem serves as a conduit of their dark design and proof to the druids of Thunder Bluff that Pythas's twisted trance has finally been broken.

faq.q: What is the Gem of Pythas used for?
aliases: what to do with gem of pythas
faq.answer: The gem is brought to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff along with the gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, and Serpentis. Together, they complete the task of putting an end to the rogue leaders of the Druids of the Fang.

aliases: where to get gem of pythas
faq.answer: It is held by Lord Pythas, a fallen night elf druid who resides deep inside the Wailing Caverns of the Barrens.

faq.q: Why do the druids of Thunder Bluff want the gem?
faq.answer: Nara Wildmane and the Cenarion druids in Thunder Bluff are haunted by the corruption radiating from the Wailing Caverns. Securing the gems proves that the four aberrant leaders have been slain, cutting off the nightmare from bleeding further into the Barrens.

faq.q: Are there other gems like this one?
faq.answer: Yes. Lord Pythas is one of four leaders. The others—Lady Anacondra, Lord Cobrahn, and Lord Serpentis—each carry their own dream gem deep inside the cavern.

angles.text: For Cenarion druids, recovering the gem is a somber duty, as it represents the utter degradation of Naralex's inner circle into serpentine horrors.
The twisted rituals in the caverns threaten the fragile balance of the Barrens, making the recovery of these gems critical to protecting the shamans' and druids' homeland.
